summary: The prepared base already supports [3, T] mRoPE in the fused QK RMSNorm+RoPE kernel by selecting each rotary lane's temporal, height, or width position through MRotaryEmbedding.axis_map. A gfx950 tensor regression matched the native rotary implementation within BF16 tolerance; replaying the historical temporal-only behavior differed by 10.5 max absolute error.

tests.what_was_measured: Existing fused kernel regression on gfx950 with only the unrelated optional CUDA PDL specialization disabled in-process: 3 tests passed, including five mRoPE subtests, against independent PyTorch and MRotaryEmbedding references. See raw/current_gpu_test_pdl_disabled.log.

Distinct-axis Qwen3.5 [11,11,10] interleaved mRoPE: current fused vs native max absolute error 0.03125 and passed BF16 tolerance; historical temporal-only replay error 10.5; equal-axis [3,T] vs 1D error 0.0. See raw/mrope_regression_gpu.log.

gpu_execution.evidence: One assigned AMD Instinct MI350X, gfx950, ROCm 7.2 was used for tensor-level fused-kernel execution. Device evidence is in raw/gpu_environment.log.
